atlas_home_region_card.compact: 1980s metal turned into neon arena pop: riffs, hooks, hair, and spectacle.
atlas_home_region_card.standard: It defined a mainstream metal memory that still shapes karaoke, classic-rock radio, and power-ballad culture.
atlas_home_region_card.deep: 1980s metal turned into neon arena pop: riffs, hooks, hair, and spectacle. It defined a mainstream metal memory that still shapes karaoke, classic-rock radio, and power-ballad culture.

region_scene_page.compact: Glam metal carried hard-rock and metal vocabulary into MTV-ready choruses, image theater, and enormous studio sound.
region_scene_page.standard: Glam metal carried hard-rock and metal vocabulary into MTV-ready choruses, image theater, and enormous studio sound. Bon Jovi's Bad Medicine, Lita Ford's Kiss Me Deadly, Quiet Riot's Cum On Feel the Noize, and Def Leppard's Photograph give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Glam metal carried hard-rock and metal vocabulary into MTV-ready choruses, image theater, and enormous studio sound. The difference is the gloss: hooks, visual identity, and chorus size are as important as riff weight. Bon Jovi's Bad Medicine, Lita Ford's Kiss Me Deadly, Quiet Riot's Cum On Feel the Noize, and Def Leppard's Photograph give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
